propositions: One environment variable (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express the required four-pass model distribution: Pass-1 finder on opus-family, Pass-2 verifier on sonnet-family, Pass-3 decide, Pass-4 coach on sonnet-family.

The code-review gate has five LLM-calling steps, of which only verify (Pass-2) declares a model class; base (Pass-1), round_a, round_b, and coach (Pass-4) inherit cfg.model implicitly instead of declaring their class.
Non-default provider runs on code-review currently resolve bare claude-* model ids to direct Anthropic instead of the configured provider, because no per-pass class mapping exists.

Step-level model declarations on batch steps are silent no-ops: interpreter.py:384-395 builds BatchRunRequest only from the batch sub-dict and never passes the enclosing step's model key, causing model_ladder to be the only operative declaration path for batch runners.
